Charlotte news, weather, traffic and sports from WCNC-TV in Charlotte, North Carolina. Stay up-to-date with the latest news, weather, sports and more in the Charlotte area with the NBC station in Charlotte.

Shows: Original local programming, Live Impact Morning News, Charlotte Today, Live Impact Afternoon News, Kids, Chaos & Coffee: Jen Hamilton opens up about viral fame, 'Birth Vibes' & navigating divorce
